import numpy as np
from collections import Counter
def f(g):
    g=np.array(g); H,W=g.shape
    cnt=Counter(g.flatten()); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    cands=[]
    for c in [x for x,_ in cnt.most_common() if x!=bg]:
        rs,cs_=np.where(g==c)
        if len(rs)==0: continue
        sub=g[rs.min():rs.max()+1, cs_.min():cs_.max()+1]
        if sub.ndim==1: continue
        ring=(sub[0,:]==c).all() and (sub[-1,:]==c).all() and (sub[:,0]==c).all() and (sub[:,-1]==c).all()
        if sub.shape[0]>2 and sub.shape[1]>2:
            inner_ok=(sub[1:-1,1:-1]!=c).all()

        if ring and inner_ok: cands.append((c,sub,(rs.min(),cs_.min())))

    cells=[(r,c_,int(g[r,c_])) for r in range(H) for c_ in range(W)

    rs=[p[0] for p in cells]; cs_=[p[1] for p in cells]

def f(g):
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    # candidate rect colors: color forming hollow box; find largest single-color region bounding box that isn't fully solid
    col=None
    for c in set(x for r in g for x in r):
        if c==bg: continue
        pts=[(r,cc) for r in range(H) for cc in range(W) if g[r][cc]==c]
        rs=[p[0] for p in pts]; cs=[p[1] for p in pts]
        r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
        if len(pts)>0 and c!=bg:
            inner=all(not(r0<=r<=r1 and c0<=c<=c1) or g[r][cc]!=c for r in range(r0+1,r1) for cc in range(c0+1,c1)) \
              and (not r0<r1 or not c0<c1)
            if c==col: continue
            col=c; (pr0,pr1,pc0,pc1)=(r0,r1,c0,c1); break
    h,w=pr1-pr0+1,pc1-pc0+1
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for r in range(pr0+1,pr1):
        for c in range(pc0+1,pc1):
            out[r][c]=bg
    obj=[(r,c,g[r][c]) for r in range(H) for c in range(W)
        if g[r][c]!=bg and not(pr0<=r<=pr1 and pc0<=c<=pc1)]
    minr,minc=min(p[0] for p in obj),min(p[1] for p in obj)
    oh=max(p[0] for p in obj)-minr+1; ow=max(p[1] for p in obj)-minc+1
    for i in range(oh):
        for j in range(ow):
            v=next(vv for pr,pc,vv in obj if pr-minr==i and pc-minc==j)
            for dr in range(2):
                for dc in range(2):
                    rr,cc=pr0+1+i*2+dr,pc0+1+j*2+dc
                    if 0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<W:
                        out[rr][cc]=v
    return out
for i in (2,3):
    gi=G[f'Demo pair {i} input']; go=G[f'Demo pair {i} output']
    print(i, f(gi)==go)

    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # find hollow rectangle frame
    best=None
    for c in set(x for r in g for x in r):
        if c==bg: continue
        pts=[(r,cc) for r in range(H) for cc in range(W) if g[r][cc]==c]
        r0=min(p[0] for p in pts); r1=max(p[0] for p in pts)
        c0=min(p[1] for p in pts); c1=max(p[1] for p in pts)
        ok=all(g[r0][cc]==c and g[r1][cc]==c for cc in range(c0,c1+1)) \
           and all(g[r][c0]==c and g[r][c1]==c for r in range(r0+1,r1))
        if ok and r1-r0>=2 and c1-c0>=2:
            best=(c,r0,r1,c0,c1); break
    col,r0,r1,c0,c1=best
    ih,iw=r1-r0-1,c1-c0-1
    obj=[(r,cc,g[r][cc]) for r in range(H) for cc in range(W)

    out=[row[:] for row in g]

    return [row[c0:c1+1] for row in out[r0:r1+1]]

from collections import Counter
def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    best=None
    for c in set(x for r in g for x in r):
        if c==bg: continue
        pts=[(r,cc) for r in range(H) for cc in range(W) if g[r][cc]==c]
        r0=min(p[0] for p in pts); r1=max(p[0] for p in pts)
        c0=min(p[1] for p in pts); c1=max(p[1] for p in pts)
        ok=all(g[r0][cc]==c and g[r1][cc]==c for cc in range(c0,c1+1)) \
           and all(g[y][c0]==c and g[y][c1]==c for y in range(r0+1,r1))
        if ok and r1-r0>=2 and c1-c0>=2:
            best=(c,r0,r1,c0,c1); break
    col,r0,r1,c0,c1=best
    ih,iw=r1-r0-1,c1-c0-1
    obj=[(r,cc,g[r][cc]) for r in range(H) for cc in range(W)
         if not(r0<=r<=r1 and c0<=cc<=c1) and g[r][cc]!=col]
    mr=min(p[0] for p in obj); mc=min(p[1] for p in obj)
    Mr=max(p[0] for p in obj); Mc=max(p[1] for p in obj)
    oh,ow=Mr-mr+1,Mc-mc+1
    pat=[[bg]*ow for _ in range(oh)]
    for r,cc,v in obj: pat[r-mr][cc-mc]=v
    sh=[[pat[i%oh][j%ow] for j in range(iw)] for i in range(ih)]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for r in range(r0+1,r1):
        for c in range(c0+1,c1):
            out[r][c]=sh[r-r0-1][c-c0-1]
    return [row[c0:c1+1] for row in out[r0:r1+1]]
for i in (2,3,4):
    print(i, solve(G[f'Demo pair {i} input'])==G[f'Demo pair {i} output'])

from collections import Counter, deque
def comps(g,bg):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]; out=[]
    for r_ in range(H):
        for c_ in range(W):
            if g[r_][c_]!=bg and not seen[r_][c_]:
                q=deque([(r_,c_)]); seen[r_][c_]=True; cells=set()
                while q:
                    y,x=q.popleft(); cells.add((y,x))
                    for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                        if 0<=ny<H and 0<=nx<W and not seen[ny][nx] and g[ny][nx]!=bg:
                            seen[ny][nx]=True; q.append((ny,nx))
                out.append(cells)
    return out
def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r_ in g for x in r_)

    for c in set(x for r_ in g for x in r_):

        pts=[(r_,cc) for r_ in range(H) for cc in range(W) if g[r_][cc]==c]

        dr=max(r0-max(p[0] for p in cc), min(p[0] for p in cc)-r1, 0)
        dc=max(c0-max(p[1] for p in cc), min(p[1] for p in cc)-c1, 0)
        return max(dr,dc)
    # objects = components strictly outside the box; keep those not containing the box color... all comps are non-bg already
    cand=sorted(((d_to_box(cc),min(p[0] for p in cc),max(p[0] for p in cc),min(p[1] for p in cc),max(p[1] for p in cc)),cc) for cc in cs
                 if min(p[0] for p in cc)<r0 or max(p[0] for p in cc)>r1 or min(p[1] for p in cc)<c0 or max(p[1] for p in cc)>c1)
    objs=cand[0][3]
    mr=min(p[0] for p in objs); mc=min(p[1] for p in objs)
    Mr=max(p[0] for p in objs); Mc=max(p[1] for p in objs)
    oh,ow=Mr-mr+1,Mc-mc+1
    pat=[[bg]*ow for _ in range(oh)]
    for (r_,c_),v in [(p,g[p[0]][p[1]]) for p in objs]: pat[r_-mr][c_-mc]=v
    sh=[[pat[i%oh][j%ow] for j in range(iw)] for i in range(ih)]

from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def solve(g, verbose=False):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r_ in g for x in r_)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # find the hollow box: closed rectangle of one color
    boxes=[]
    for c in set(x for r_ in g for x in r_):
        if c==bg: continue
        pts=[(r_,cc) for r_ in range(H) for cc in range(W) if g[r_][cc]==c]
        r0=min(p[0] for p in pts); r1=max(p[0] for p in pts)
        c0=min(p[1] for p in pts); c1=max(p[1] for p in pts)
        if r1-r0<2 or c1-c0<2: continue
        if (all(g[r0][x]==c and g[r1][x]==c for x in range(c0,c1+1)) and
            all(g[y][c0]==c and g[y][c1]==c for y in range(r0,r1+1))):
            boxes.append((c,r0,r1,c0,c1))
    col,r0,r1,c0,c1=sorted(boxes)[0][1:]
    ih,iw=r1-r0-1,c1-c0-1
    # objects: non-bg, non-box-color cells strictly outside box
    objs=[(r_,c_,g[r_][c_]) for r_ in range(H) for c_ in range(W)
          if not(r0<=r_<=r1 and c0<=c_<=c1) and g[r_][c_]!=col]
    mr=min(p[0] for p in objs); mc=min(p[1] for p in objs)
    Mr=max(p[0] for p in objs); Mc=max(p[1] for p in objs)
    oh,ow=Mr-mr+1,Mc-mc+1
    pat=[[bg]*ow for _ in range(oh)]
    for r_,c_,v in objs: pat[r_-mr][c_-mc]=v
    fr=iw//ow; fc=ih//oh
    sh=[[bg]*iw for _ in range(ih)]
    for i in range(ih):
        for j in range(iw):
            sh[i][j]=pat[i%oh][j%ow]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for r in range(r0+1,r1):
        for c in range(c0+1,c1):
            out[r][c]=sh[r-r0-1][c-c0-1]
    res=[row[c0:c1+1] for row in out[r0:r1+1]]
    if verbose:
        print('box',col,(r0,r1,c0,c1),'obj bbox',(mr,mc,Mr,Mc),'pat:')
        for row in pat: print(' ',' '.join(map(str,row)))
        print('interior want:')
        for row in res[1:-1]: print(' ',' '.join(map(str,row)))
    return res

for i in (2,3,4):
    o=solve(G[f'Demo pair {i} input'],True); go=G[f'Demo pair {i} output']
    print(i,'match:',o==go)
    if o!=go:
        for ra,rb in zip(o,go):

def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}

        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r_ in g for x in r_)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    best=None
    for c in set(x for r_ in g for x in r_):
        if c==bg: continue
        pts=[(r_,cc) for r_ in range(H) for cc in range(W) if g[r_][cc]==c]
        r0=min(p[0] for p in pts); r1=max(p[0] for p in pts)
        c0=min(p[1] for p in pts); c1=max(p[1] for p in pts)
        if r1-r0<2 or c1-c0<2: continue
        if (all(g[r0][x]==c and g[r1][x]==c for x in range(c0,c1+1)) and
            all(g[y][c0]==c and g[y][c1]==c for y in range(r0,r1+1))) and (best is None or (r1-r0)*(c1-c0)<best[0]):
            best=((r1-r0)*(c1-c0),c,r0,r1,c0,c1)
    _,col,r0,r1,c0,c1=best
    ih,iw=r1-r0-1,c1-c0-1
    # objects: non-bg, non-box-color cells strictly outside the box rect
    objs=[(r_,c_,g[r_][c_]) for r_ in range(H) for c_ in range(W)
          if not(r0<r_<r1 and c0<c_<c1) and g[r_][c_]!=col]
    mr=min(p[0] for p in objs); mc=min(p[1] for p in objs)
    Mr=max(p[0] for p in objs); Mc=max(p[1] for p in objs)
    oh,ow=Mr-mr+1,Mc-mc+1
    pat=[[bg]*ow for _ in range(oh)]
    for r_,c_,v in objs: pat[r_-mr][c_-mc]=v
    sh=[[pat[i//fr][j//fc] for j in range(iw)] for i in range(ih)]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for r in range(r0+1,r1):
        for c in range(c0+1,c1):
            out[r][c]=sh[r-r0-1][c-c0-1]
    return [row[c0:c1+1] for row in out[r0:r1+1]]

for i in (2,3,4):
    o=solve(G[f'Demo pair {i} input']); go=G[f'Demo pair {i} output']

from collections import Counter
def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r_ in g for x in r_)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    best=None
    for c in set(x for r_ in g for x in r_):
        if c==bg: continue
        pts=[(r_,cc) for r_ in range(H) for cc in range(W) if g[r_][cc]==c]
        r0=min(p[0] for p in pts); r1=max(p[0] for p in pts)
        c0=min(p[1] for p in pts); c1=max(p[1] for p in pts)
        if r1-r0<2 or c1-c0<2: continue
        if (all(g[r0][x]==c and g[r1][x]==c for x in range(c0,c1+1)) and
            all(g[y][c0]==c and g[y][c1]==c for y in range(r0,r1+1))) and (best is None or (r1-r0)*(c1-c0)<best[0]):
            best=((r1-r0)*(c1-c0),c,r0,r1,c0,c1)
    _,col,r0,r1,c0,c1=best
    ih,iw=r1-r0-1,c1-c0-1
    objs=[(r_,c_,g[r_][c_]) for r_ in range(H) for c_ in range(W)
          if not(r0<=r_<=r1 and c0<=c_<=c1) and g[r_][c_]!=col]
    mr=min(p[0] for p in objs); mc=min(p[1] for p in objs)
    Mr=max(p[0] for p in objs); Mc=max(p[1] for p in objs)
    oh,ow=Mr-mr+1,Mc-mc+1
    sh=int(ih/oh); sw=int(iw/ow)
    pat=[[g[r_-mr+sh*p][c_-mc+sw*q] if False else bg for q in range(ow)] for p in range(oh)]
    pat=[[g[r_-mr][c_-mc] for c_-mc in range(ow)] for r_-mr in range(oh)]
    # paint scaled pattern into interior, keeping box frame untouched except overwrite? box edges keep col
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for i in range(ih):
        for j in range(iw):
            v=pat[i//sh][j//sw] if (i%sh<i%sh+1) and (j%sw<j%sw+1) else bg
            out[r0+1+i][c0+1+j]=v
    return [row[c0:c1+1] for row in out[r0:r1+1]]

for i in (2,3,4):
    o=solve(G[f'Demo pair {i} input']); go=G[f'Demo pair {i} output']
    print(i,'match:',o==go)
    if o!=go:
        for ra,rb in zip(o,go):
            if ra!=rb: print(' '.join(map(str,ra)),'|',' '.join(map(str,rb)))

from collections import Counter
def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r_ in g for x in r_)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    best=None
    for c in set(x for r_ in g for x in r_):
        if c==bg: continue
        pts=[(r_,cc) for r_ in range(H) for cc in range(W) if g[r_][cc]==c]
        r0=min(p[0] for p in pts); r1=max(p[0] for p in pts)
        c0=min(p[1] for p in pts); c1=max(p[1] for p in pts)
        if r1-r0<2 or c1-c0<2: continue
        if (all(g[r0][x]==c and g[r1][x]==c for x in range(c0,c1+1)) and
            all(g[y][c0]==c and g[y][c1]==c for y in range(r0,r1+1))) and (best is None or (r1-r0)*(c1-c0)<best[0]):
            best=((r1-r0)*(c1-c0),c,(r0,r1,c0,c1))
    _,col,(r0,r1,c0,c1)=best
    ih,iw=r1-r0-1,c1-c0-1
    objs=[(r_,c_,g[r_][c_]) for r_ in range(H) for c_ in range(W)
          if not(r0<=r_<=r1 and c0<=c_<=c1) and g[r_][c_]!=bg and g[r_][c_]!=col]
    mr=min(p[0] for p in objs); mc=min(p[1] for p in objs)
    Mr=max(p[0] for p in objs); Mc=max(p[1] for p in objs)
    oh,ow=Mr-mr+1,Mc-mc+1
    sr=sc_=max(1,ih//oh); scc=max(1,iw//ow)
    pat=[[g[rr][cc] for cc in range(mc,Mc+1)] for rr in range(mr,Mr+1)]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for i in range(ih):
        for j in range(iw):
            oi=i//sr; oj=j//sc_
            out[r0+1+i][c0+1+j]=pat[oi][oj]
    return [row[c0:c1+1] for row in out[r0:r1+1]]

for i in (2,3,4):
    o=solve(G[f'Demo pair {i} input']); go=G[f'Demo pair {i} output']
    print(i,'match:',o==go)
    if o!=go:
        for ra,rb in zip(o,go):
            if ra!=rb: print(' '.join(map(str,ra)),'|',' '.join(map(str,rb)))
